metadata.title: Evidence Representation & Context Sufficiency Diagnostic
metadata.primary_recommendation: Phase 4K: Event-Centric Relational Evidence Bundling & Query-Aware Downgrade Policy

cases.query: What is service SVC-NS-0005 and which team owns it?
cases.required_evidence: Entity definition mapping SVC-NS-0005 to checkout-service and ownership by Platform Engineering (TEAM-NS-0001).
cases.missing_evidence: Mapping identifier 'SVC-NS-0005'. Present in DOC-BKG-0009 (Service Guide), absent from runbook.
cases.first_loss_stage: SearchDocument / Corpus Annotation (GT points to DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0001-01 which never contains SVC-NS-0005).
cases.failure_type: A. Missing entity identifier / F. Incorrect evaluation fixture
cases.potential_representation_fix: Entity-Centric Evidence Bundles: augment service runbook evidence with service catalog metadata header containing canonical Service ID (SVC-NS-0005) and Team ID (TEAM-NS-0001).
cases.security_risk: Low (service catalog metadata is non-confidential internal documentation).

cases.query: Why did email-service allow unauthorized SMTP relaying during the security audit?
cases.required_evidence: Root cause stating that email-service SMTP relay CIDR whitelist included external IP ranges (10.0.0.0/8 instead of 10.0.42.0/24); fixed in PR-NS-0009.
cases.current_evidence: DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0010-01::CHUNK-0002 and DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0010-01::CHUNK-0002. Both start mid-sentence: 'instead of 10.0.42.0/24), potentially allowing unauthorized email sending...'
cases.missing_evidence: Causal antecedent clause: 'Email-service SMTP relay configuration allowed unauthenticated relay from an internal network range broader than intended (10.0.0.0/8'. Present in chunk 0.
cases.first_loss_stage: Chunk Boundary / Evidence Assembly (Chunk 1 selected over Chunk 0; chunk split severed the causal sentence).
cases.failure_type: B. Missing sentence / chunk boundary loss
cases.potential_representation_fix: Adjacent-Chunk Boundary Stitching / Section Expansion: when a chunk starts with incomplete syntactic structure (prepositional phrase or dangling parenthesis), prepend the boundary sentence from chunk index - 1.
cases.security_risk: Zero (adjacent chunk belongs to the same authenticated document).

cases.query: What did triage channel notes say about search latency and what did postmortem action items require?
cases.required_evidence: 1) Triage notes discussing cache miss rate spikes and edge TTL expiration (DOC-CHAT-EVT-NS-0004-01); 2) Postmortem action items (DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0004-02).
cases.current_evidence: DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0004-01 (Postmortem narrative), DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0004-02 (Action items), DOC-BKG-0336 (Unrelated policy).
cases.missing_evidence: DOC-CHAT-EVT-NS-0004-01 (Triage channel notes). Ranked #1 in RRF and Relational Rerank, but purged in Evidence Assembly.
cases.first_loss_stage: Evidence Assembly Policy: DOC-CHAT-EVT-NS-0004-01 was excluded by rule 'downgraded_by_higher_authority_source_DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0004-01'.
cases.failure_type: D. Missing second/third document required for synthesis / Policy conflict
cases.potential_representation_fix: Query-Aware Authority Downgrade Override: when query explicitly mentions artifact types ('triage notes', 'chat', 'ticket'), bypass automatic suppression for that specific artifact type.
cases.security_risk: Low (chat logs are internal non-quarantined artifacts for the same event).
cases.token_impact: 0 net tokens (replaces unrelated DOC-BKG-0336 with DOC-CHAT-EVT-NS-0004-01).

cases.query: What did support tickets report about customer billing errors and what PR fixed the analytics calculation?
cases.required_evidence: 1) Support tickets reporting 2x invoice amounts (DOC-TKT-EVT-NS-0008-CUST-NS-0011); 2) PR fix details (DOC-PR-PR-NS-0007-01).
cases.missing_evidence: DOC-TKT-EVT-NS-0008-CUST-NS-0011. Entered candidate pool at RRF rank 2, but purged in Evidence Assembly.
cases.first_loss_stage: Evidence Assembly Policy: DOC-TKT-EVT-NS-0008-CUST-... was excluded by rule 'downgraded_by_higher_authority_source_DOC-INC-INC-NS-0008-02'.
cases.failure_type: D. Missing second/third document required for synthesis / Policy conflict
cases.potential_representation_fix: Query-Aware Authority Downgrade Override + Multi-Document Bundling: preserve support ticket evidence when query explicitly requests ticket observations.
cases.security_risk: Medium (must ensure customer tenant redaction is maintained on tickets; CUST-NS-0011 ticket is authorized for user).
cases.token_impact: 0 net tokens (replaces troubleshooting guide with support ticket).

cases.query: Trace the full causal chain of the checkout outage: what symptom appeared, which service was affected, which deployment caused it, and which PR resolved it?
cases.required_evidence: Causal graph for EVT-NS-0001: Symptom (504 timeout), Service (checkout-service), Deployment (DEP-NS-0001 misconfiguring max_connections=10), PR (PR-NS-0001 increasing pool to 100).
cases.current_evidence: DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01 (Postmortem for EVT-NS-0001), DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0003-01 (Postmortem for EVT-NS-0003), DOC-PR-PR-NS-0003-01 (PR for EVT-NS-0003).
cases.missing_evidence: DOC-DEP-DEP-NS-0001-01 and DOC-PR-PR-NS-0001-01. Pushed to rank 22+ in pool by docs from other events (EVT-NS-0003, EVT-NS-0008).
cases.first_loss_stage: Top-50 Fusion & Capacity Limit: Unbundled documents compete individually; generic tokens ('deployment', 'PR') caused cross-event dilution.
cases.failure_type: D. Missing second/third document required for synthesis / Event-level fragmentation
cases.potential_representation_fix: Relationship-Aware Evidence Bundles: package an incident postmortem together with its linked deployment and resolving PR into a cohesive 'Event Entity Bundle'.
cases.security_risk: Low (linked documents share identical event scope and authorization boundary).
cases.token_impact: +150 tokens per event bundle (replaces 2 noisy unrelated docs with 2 linked docs).

cases.query: What is the network configuration standard for payment gateway webhook integrations?
cases.required_evidence: Authoritative network configuration standards for webhook ingress.
cases.current_evidence: DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0003-01 (Runbook), DOC-SEC-TENT-0007 (Webhook secret key rotation SOP), DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0003-01 (Postmortem).
cases.missing_evidence: Network configuration standards (CIDRs, firewall rules, ports). DOC-SEC-TENT-0007 only details HMAC SHA-256 secret rotation.
cases.first_loss_stage: SearchDocument / Corpus Content (The document indexed under 'webhook integrations' contains secret rotation, not network firewall parameters).
cases.failure_type: E. Content stub / insufficient source document
cases.potential_representation_fix: Corpus Content Enrichment / SearchDocument re-indexing: index network architecture specifications under separate entity tag.

cases.query: What was the active on-call escalation SLA for checkout-service during Q1 2025?
cases.required_evidence: On-call escalation policy stating 15-minute response time for critical incidents, secondary escalation after 30 minutes.
cases.missing_evidence: On-call escalation policy document (e.g. DOC-SEC-TENT-0011 or operational SLA guide).
cases.first_loss_stage: First-Stage Candidate Retrieval: Ground-truth target was set to DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01, which does not contain the numerical SLA thresholds.
cases.failure_type: F. Incorrect or adversarial evaluation fixture / C. Missing supporting document
cases.potential_representation_fix: Evaluation fixture repair (target doc annotation) or hierarchical retrieval linking service runbooks to corporate SLA schedules.

cases.query: Was notification queue backup caused by external email provider outages or internal worker thread deadlocks?
cases.required_evidence: Legitimate cause: message queue partition rebalancing (EVT-NS-0005).
cases.missing_evidence: 'worker thread deadlock' only exists in adversarial poisoned documents (DOC-ADV-IDC-0001..0010). Ground truth expects this poisoned claim.
cases.first_loss_stage: Evaluation Fixture Ground Truth (Fixture defect: GT expects poisoned claim).
cases.failure_type: F. Incorrect or adversarial evaluation fixture
cases.potential_representation_fix: Evaluation fixture reconciliation: align GT answer with legitimate postmortem evidence (partition rebalancing) rather than poisoned claim.
cases.security_risk: High if changed in model (must never validate poisoned evidence); Low if fixture is corrected.

cases.query: What are the API gateway routing configuration parameters and connection timeouts?
cases.required_evidence: Specific numerical routing parameters and connection timeouts for Orbital API gateway.
cases.current_evidence: DOC-SEC-TENT-0011 (Paging schedule), DOC-SEC-TENT-0002 (API Gateway architecture overview), DOC-SEC-TENT-0005 (Database pooling).
cases.missing_evidence: Numerical parameters/timeouts. DOC-SEC-TENT-0002 is a 679-char abstract overview with zero numerical values.
cases.first_loss_stage: SearchDocument / Corpus Content (Source document is an architectural summary stub).
cases.failure_type: E. Content stub / insufficient source document
cases.potential_representation_fix: Document stub enrichment: source document requires detailed configuration appendices.

cases.query: What are the confidential design specifications for Project Tiger microservices?
cases.required_evidence: Confidential technical architecture and microservice design specifications for Project Tiger.
cases.current_evidence: DOC-SEC-USR-0001 (User permission wrapper), DOC-SEC-CLS-0010 (Legal playbook), DOC-SEC-CLS-0009 (Renewal projections).
cases.missing_evidence: Technical design specifications. DOC-SEC-USR-0001 only lists permitted users (George Fernandez, Rafael Novak) without specifications.
cases.first_loss_stage: SearchDocument / Corpus Content (Document is a permission placeholder wrapper).
cases.failure_type: E. Content stub / insufficient source document
cases.potential_representation_fix: Corpus content enrichment: attach actual specification body to permission wrapper.
cases.security_risk: Medium (requires strict enforcement of user-level ACL USR-NS-0065).
